jobs.description:
As a Data Architect at Sopra Steria, you will play a key role in shaping data strategies and designing end-to-end solutions for clients across various industries. You will define and implement data architectures that support business objectives, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. By analysing customer needs and translating them into robust data models and frameworks, you’ll deliver solutions that turn data into actionable insights. Leveraging your expertise across the entire data value chain, you will guide clients through their digital transformation journey and support the successful implementation of Sopra Steria’s diverse portfolio of data services.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• You have a background in Data Engineering or Data Analyses.
• At least 3 years of experience as a Data Architect.
• You are able to design and set up end-to-end data solutions.
• You collect, analyze and match customer demand with a meaningful design.
• You have good knowledge and experience with SQL, Data modeling concepts and ETL best practices.
• You have practical experience with Microsoft cloud or comparable alternatives.
• Knowledge of a programming language like Python is a plus.
• Experience with using and implementing AI in your and the client’s workflow is a plus.
• You have analytical thinking, communication skills and a practical attitude.
• You are proficient in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a must.

We are looking for a Network Engineer with a strong focus on Azure Cloud to help design, evolve, and operate our customers hybrid network infrastructures. You will play a key role in integrating on-premises environments with Azure in a secure, scalable, and highly available way.

In this role, you combine deep networking expertise with strong knowledge of Azure networking services, working closely with Cloud, Security, and Architecture teams. You take ownership of complex network topics and help shape a modern, cloud-ready and future-proof infrastructure.

Your days will consist of automating and maintaining the systems of our customers, as well as optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms, automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation.

Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a Network Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
• At least 4 years of experience as a Network Engineer
• Proven experience of Cloud networking in hybrid network architectures (Azure, AWS)
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and Cloud architecture principles.
• Experience implementing, monitoring and troubleshooting Azure building blocks (ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, Azure DNS,…).
• Implement and maintain network security solutions, including firewalls, network segmentation and Zero-Trust environments.
• Practice of Automation tools is an asset.
• Fluent in English, French and Dutch
Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CCNA/CCNP.
• Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Ansible, Terraform, ARM templates).
• 
Clear written and oral communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business goals.
• Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource requirements.
• Manage budgets, risks, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.
• Coordinate and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve project milestones.
• Ensure effective communication with stakeholders and provide regular progress updates.
• Identify potential issues and proactively implement solutions.
• Guarantee quality standards and compliance with company processes and methodologies.
• Conduct post-project evaluations to capture lessons learned and improve future performance.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree/Master's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, IT, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience as a Project Manager 3 in IT
• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
• Strong leadership and communication abilities.
• Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Asana, Trello).
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
• PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certification is a plus.
• Languages: Fluent in French & English OR Dutch & English.

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. • Master’s degree in a technical or scientific field (industrial, civil, or bio-engineering)

Profile

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

Are you a technically skilled engineer with a passion for pharmaceutical processes? As a Project Engineer, you will contribute to various engineering projects. You’ll be responsible for the full project lifecycle of specific installations or equipment: from specification and procurement to installation, validation, and handover to operations. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams, monitor planning and budget, and ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution. You’ll also be part of creating technical solutions and be included in the technical follow-up with suppliers. You take ownership of your scope, communicate proactively with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous improvement.

As an AI Engineer, you bring traditional and Generative AI into real world use cases by helping our clients design, build, and serve Generative AI solutions. You design and implement solutions that require from traditional AI to LLMs, from semantic search to conversational AI. You train, fine-tune, improve, and deploy ML models. Furthermore, you write production ready code to serve online, batch, and real time models. You build applications and software to serve AI driven use cases.  

You work in close collaboration with Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers and Data Engineers, to integrate all parts of the solution. You help build solutions and/or operate with our clients on a medium to long-term basis. 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in AI consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. You will be part of the Data & AI team, where we tackle AI challenges end to end, from strategy, governance, to science and engineering. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, MLOps Engineer, or in a similar position 
• Experience with traditional NLP, LLMs, and conversational AI, both in experimentation phase and in production 
• Experience with vector databases for semantic search and RAG solutions in a production environment. 
• Strong software engineering background and ability to write production ready code in Python 
• Experience with experiment tracking, models monitoring, LLM and NLP evaluation techniques, and deployment strategies 
• Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles 
• Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem 
• Able to coach others, give technical advice and direction, and work independently 
• Master or PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
• Proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

Your role

As a Data Migration Expert (SAP), you'll be at the forefront of designing and executing data migration strategies that ensure smooth and efficient transitions across systems. Your role will be pivotal in overseeing data migration projects, from initial planning through to execution and validation. You'll ensure that data is accurately and securely transferred between systems, maintaining integrity and consistency throughout the process. Utilizing advanced tools like SAP migration cockpit and EMIGALL, you’ll streamline migration workflows and resolve any challenges that arise. If you’re passionate about orchestrating complex data migrations and want to lead in a cutting-edge environment, this position is for you.

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data migration consultant on data migration and data governance projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, data gathering, data cleansing and validation, development, testing, and execution of the migration.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions

 

Knowledge & Experience

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in executing (SAP) migration projects, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on end-to-end migration lifecycles.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of the migrated data by cleansing, transforming and validating data. This requires the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, and data analysis tools such as MS Excel or Access.
• Data migration: planning, executing and managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new target environments. This involves ensuring seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, which requires proficiency in data migration tools such as S/4HANA migration cockpit, Emigall and/or LSMW. Knowledge of ETL tools as SAP Data services or Datasphere is a plus.
• Data migration planning: Strong team management skills are necessary to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, ensuring that all members are aligned with project goals and timelines. This includes delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support, fostering a collaborative work environment, and managing stakeholder expectations.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• You are a proactive, results-driven team player with strong communication skills, a customer-oriented approach, and a consultancy mindset, capable of collaborating with diverse colleagues and confidently representing Capgemini to clients.
• Resident in Belgium.
• Fluent in Dutch/French and English.
• Geographic mobility. We serve customers throughout Belgium.

About Capgemini
Capgemini is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services. The Group is at the forefront of innovation to address the entire breadth of clients’ opportunities in the evolving world of cloud, digital and platforms. Building on its strong 50-year+ heritage and deep industry-specific expertise, Capgemini enables organizations to realize their business ambitions through an array of services from strategy to operations. Capgemini is driven by the conviction that the business value of technology comes from and through people. Today, it is a multicultural company of 300,000 team members in almost 50 countries.
 

Key tasks & activities
As an experienced SAP PS/PPM (Project Systems/ Project & Portfolio Management) functional consultant, you will be responsible for translating the business challenges of our customers into IT requirements based on SAP’s latest technologies in the area of PS and/or PPM. As part of a team of consultants, you will guide your customer in implementing, testing and delivering the solution.

Knowledge & Experience

• Master’s degree
• A good knowledge of the SAP solution portfolio for PS and/or PPM
• +3 years of experience in SAP PS and/or PPM
• SAP trainings or certifications are an asset
• Team player with strong communication skills and with a collaborative spirit
• Able to coach, support, train and develop junior consultants
• Customer oriented, result driven & focused on delivering quality
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Willing to work on assignments in Belgium and potentially abroad
• Belgian residency
